/ai-automation-builder/sales-automation.note: specificity: PRICING CELL OFF-CATEGORY. why_table Emergent pricing: 'Credits, no per-approver seats, no task cap'. Against Salesforce Sales Cloud ('Per user, per month by edition') and HubSpot Sales Hub ('Per seat, per month'), the seat that costs a sales team money is the rep's, not an approver's; 'per-approver seats' is approval-workflow language (catalogue row 8) and 'no task cap' answers Zapier-style task pricing that neither CRM uses. The sales variant in rules/competitors/aab.json has no pricing override, so the hub default leaks in. Library change for Divit: a sales pricing variant built on the approved claim 'the built app has no per-seat pricing', e.g. 'Credits; reps are not billed as seats'. Same class elsewhere: faq10 'runs on credits with no task cap' (answers a per-user question with a task-cap point). GENERIC: meta_title 'Built Around Your Process' could head any hub page; name the sales job instead. | craft: TACKED-ON ', and' ENDINGS: 11 sentences in prose fields bolt a second outcome on after a comma, so the sentence ends on an afterthought, not the important word: feature_2 ', and the outcome is written to the deal record in the CRM.'; feature_3 ', and no rep spends Friday afternoon typing it in.'; tab_content_1 'The rep gets a Slack alert, and the owner is set in HubSpot.'; tab_content_3 ', and its owner gets the deal value in Slack.'; tab_content_4 'The list posts to Slack on Monday, and a renewal opportunity opens in the CRM for each account.'; faq3 'Most CRMs include some of it, and teams that need more add a layer on top.'; faq4 ', and it runs on any CRM, HubSpot and Pipedrive included.'; faq5 ', and managers get a forecast built from the deals that are open today.'; faq8 'A form fill starts a nurture sequence, and a reply books a meeting.'; faq10 ', and it is free to start.'; howto_step_5 ', and it repeats daily until someone acts on it.' Each repeated idea should appear once, the second place should add something new (catalogue row 18). | truth: 1) why_table Emergent pricing 'no per-approver seats, no task cap': not meaningful against per-user CRMs (see specificity); Salesforce and HubSpot do not sell by task, so 'no task cap' implies a limit they do not have (catalogue row 8 class). 2) faq4 'No. Salesforce automation means the flows and rules configured inside Salesforce' is stated as settled; 'salesforce automation' is widely used as a spelling of sales force automation (the term predates the company).
